# IRaft
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IRaft.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IRaftEvents](../events/i-raft-events.md), [IRaftErrors](../errors/i-raft-errors.md)

**Title:**
IRaft

Interface for the Raft contract which manages harvesting, auctioning, and reinvesting of rewards.

This interface defines the core functionality for managing rewards from various Arks.


## Functions
### harvestAndStartAuction

Harvests rewards from the specified Ark and starts an auction for the harvested tokens

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Harvests rewards from the specified Ark
- Starts an auction for each harvested token

- effects: 
- Updates obtainedTokens mapping
- Creates new auctions

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure only authorized addresses can call this function
- Validate input parameters


```solidity
function harvestAndStartAuction(address ark, bytes calldata rewardData) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract to harvest rewards from|
|`rewardData`|`bytes`|Additional data required by a protocol to harvest|


### harvest

Harvests rewards from the specified Ark without auctioning or reinvesting

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Calls the harvest function on the specified Ark
- Updates the obtainedTokens mapping with harvested amounts

- effects: 
- Updates obtainedTokens mapping

- security-considerations: 
- Validate the Ark address
- Ensure proper handling of rewardData


```solidity
function harvest(address ark, bytes calldata rewardData) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract to harvest rewards from|
|`rewardData`|`bytes`|Additional data required by a protocol to harvest|


### socializeLosses

Socializes losses from the specified Ark and reward token

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Sweeps the tokens from the Ark
- Transfers the tokens to the caller (governor) who socialized the losses

- effects: 
- Updates the obtainedTokens mapping
- Transfers the tokens to the caller (governor) who socialized the losses

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure only authorized addresses can call this function (governor)
- Validate the Ark address and token address


```solidity
function socializeLosses(address ark, address[] calldata tokens, address receiver) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract to socialize losses from|
|`tokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens to socialize losses from ( e.g. receipt tokens)|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address of the receiver who will receive the tokens (e.g. treasury)|


### sweep

Sweeps tokens from the specified Ark and returns them to the caller

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Calls the sweep function on the specified Ark
- Updates the obtainedTokens mapping with swept amounts

- effects: 
- Updates obtainedTokens mapping
- Transfers swept tokens to the contract

- security-considerations: 
- Validate input parameters


```solidity
function sweep(
    address ark,
    address[] calldata tokens
)
    external
    returns (address[] memory sweptTokens, uint256[] memory sweptAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract to sweep tokens from|
|`tokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens to sweep|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sweptTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens that were swept|
|`sweptAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the tokens that were swept|


### sweepAndStartAuction

Sweeps tokens from the specified Ark and starts an auction for them

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Sweeps specified tokens from the Ark
- Starts an auction for each swept token

- effects: 
- Updates obtainedTokens mapping
- Creates new auctions

- security-considerations: 
- Validate input parameters


```solidity
function sweepAndStartAuction(address ark, address[] calldata tokens) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract to sweep tokens from|
|`tokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens to sweep|


### startAuction

Starts a Dutch auction for the harvested rewards of a specific Ark and reward token

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Creates a new auction for the specified reward token
- Resets obtainedTokens and unsoldTokens for the given Ark and reward token

- effects: 
- Creates a new auction
- Updates obtainedTokens and unsoldTokens mappings

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure only authorized addresses can call this function
- Check for existing auctions before starting a new one


```solidity
function startAuction(address ark, address rewardToken) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token to be auctioned|


### buyTokens

Allows users to buy tokens from an active auction

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Retrieves the auction data for the specified Ark and reward token
- Calls the buyTokens function of the DutchAuctionLibrary
- Updates the paymentTokensToBoard mapping
- Settles the auction if all tokens are sold

- effects: 
- Transfers tokens between the buyer and the contract
- Updates the auction state
- May settle the auction if all tokens are sold

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure proper token transfers and balance updates
- Handle potential reentrancy risks


```solidity
function buyTokens(address ark, address rewardToken, uint256 amount) external returns (uint256 paymentAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token being auctioned|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to purchase|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`paymentAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of payment tokens required to purchase the specified amount of reward tokens|


### finalizeAuction

Finalizes an auction after its end time has been reached

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Retrieves the auction data
- Calls the finalizeAuction function of the DutchAuctionLibrary
- Settles the auction
- if an ark doesn't require keeper data, the raised funds will be boarded autoamtically

- effects: 
- Updates the auction state
- May transfer unsold tokens
- May initiate boarding of payment tokens

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure the auction has ended before finalizing
- Handle potential edge cases with unsold tokens


```solidity
function finalizeAuction(address ark, address rewardToken) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token that was auctioned|


### getCurrentPrice

Gets the current price of tokens in an ongoing auction

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Retrieves the auction data
- Calls the getCurrentPrice function of the DutchAuctionLibrary

- effects: 
- No state changes (view function)

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure the auction is ongoing when calling this function


```solidity
function getCurrentPrice(address ark, address rewardToken) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The current price of the auction|


### board

Boards the auctioned token to an Ark

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Checks if the Ark requires keeper data
- Approves and boards the payment tokens to the Ark

- effects: 
- Transfers payment tokens to the Ark
- Resets the paymentTokensToBoard mapping

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure only authorized addresses can call this function
- Validate the Ark address and data
- Handle potential failures in the boarding process


```solidity
function board(address ark, address rewardToken, bytes calldata data) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark contract|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token to board the rewards to|
|`data`|`bytes`|Additional data required by the Ark to board rewards|


### setSweepableToken

Sets whether a token can be swept from an Ark

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Sets the sweepableTokens mapping for the specified Ark and token

- effects: 
- Updates the sweepableTokens mapping

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure only authorized addresses can call this function (curator)
- Validate the Ark address and token address


```solidity
function setSweepableToken(address ark, address token, bool isSweepable) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark|
|`token`|`address`|The token address|
|`isSweepable`|`bool`|Whether the token should be sweepable|


### setNonSweepableToken

**Notes:**
- internal-logic:

- effects:

- security-considerations:

- Validate the Ark address and token address


```solidity
function setNonSweepableToken(address ark, address token, bool isNonSweepable) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|

|`token`|`address`|The token address|
|`isNonSweepable`|`bool`|Whether the token should be non-sweepable|
